text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser suffers a defeat 
against Twin Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as they were talking about how 
amazing Twin Turbo was today and how her 
sheer determination to win shone through—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Overjoyed by her victory over 
Matikanetannhauser, Twin Turbo was seen 
sprinting off in the completely opposite 
direction of the academy...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a series of events, they safely 
caught Twin Turbo, and the two headed home 
together on good terms.
